tests.name: System File Copied to Unusual Location
tests.description: It may be suspicious seeing a file copy of an EXE in System32 or SysWOW64 to a non-system directory or executing from a non-system directory.

tests.name: Malware Masquerading and Execution from Zip File
tests.description: When the file is unzipped and the README.cmd file opened, it executes and changes the .pdf to .dll and executes the dll. This is a BazaLoader technique [as reported here](https://twitter.com/ffforward/status/1481672378639912960)

tests.name: Masquerading File Extension Restoration via PowerShell and esentutl
tests.description:
Simulates the technique of restoring or altering file extensions using the built-in Windows database utility esentutl.exe via PowerShell. 
Threat actors such as menuPass (G0045) have leveraged esentutl to copy and rename files (such as changing payloads masquerading as .txt back to true executable types) to evade defenses and bypass simple name-based monitoring.
